title: Nonnegativity of the optimum
statement: Let a finite-domain constraint satisfaction problem have a nonempty multiset of constraints, with every declared variable occurring in some constraint scope. If both the domain and the variable set are finite and the domain is nonempty, then the optimum value is nonnegative.
